fields.description: Start of the invoice number, such as MIMT/26-27/. Letters, numbers, / and - only. Leave blank to use the Sales Invoice naming series. The whole number stays within 16 characters.
fields.label: Prefix

fields.description: First number to issue when this series has nothing higher yet. Use this to continue from the old billing software: if the last old bill was 150, enter 151. Leave 0 to start at 1. A later invoice in ERPNext still wins: the next number is one past the highest serial already used.
fields.label: Starting number
